summary: UI redesign verification: Glassmorphism dark theme with softer emerald accent (#10B981). All requested features tested and working correctly. Auth page, Dashboard, Team page, Friendly Matches, and Calendar all display correctly with new styling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI redesign with glassmorphism dark theme verified. All navigation flows working. Team cards show flags, badges (format, gender, age), PLR/AVL counts, team codes. Network cards expandable with Manager/Phone details. Calendar shows Cancelled matches with red badge and strikethrough.

Auth Page - Glassmorphism Styling.details: Auth page renders with dark background (#0F1115), glass-effect card with subtle borders, LOG IN/SIGN UP tabs with emerald accent (#10B981). Input fields have glassBorder styling.

Dashboard - TACTICAL LINEUP Branding.details: Dashboard shows TACTICAL LINEUP title with strategy icon, THE ELITE COACH ASSISTANT subtitle. LinearGradient background applied correctly.

Dashboard - CREATE NEW SQUAD Section.details: Football card shows shoe-cleat icon with '5v5 · 7v7 · 9v9 · 11v11' formats. Futsal card shows soccer icon with '5v5'. Both cards have glass effect styling.

Dashboard - MY ACTIVE TEAMS Section.details: 4 team cards displayed: Storm G14 (9v9, U14), Test England Team (5v5, Boys U12, England flag), Blitz Futsal (5v5, Senior, Spain flag), Ørn FK (11v11, Senior). Each shows format badge, gender/age badge, team code, PLR count, AVL count.

Dashboard - MY NETWORK Section.details: Network team 'Monolitten 2012' displayed with U14 and 11v11 badges. Card is expandable - clicking shows Manager and Phone contact details with Remove option.

Dashboard - Add to Network Modal.details: + Add to Network button opens modal with 'Add Team' title, team code input field (placeholder 'e.g. ABC123'), ADD TO NETWORK and CANCEL buttons.

Team Navigation.details: Clicking team card navigates to team page. Team page shows team name with flag, format/sport badges, PLR/AVL counts, TEAM CODE display.

Team Page - Sidebar Menu.details: All 7 menu items visible and accessible: Squad, Tactics, Calendar, Friendly, Training, History, Match. Each has colored icon background.

Friendly Matches Page.details: Page shows UPCOMING MATCHES section with accepted match details (opponent, date, location), GO TO MATCH/AMEND/CANCEL buttons. CANCELLED/DECLINED section shows cancelled matches. + INVITE button in header.

Calendar Page.details: Match Calendar displays events grouped by month (February 2026, March 2026). Friendly matches show green 'Friendly' badge. Cancelled matches show red 'Cancelled' badge with strikethrough on opponent name. 'No date' section for unscheduled events.
